name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-content-exists-risk
description: Content-moderation rescue for dsh: a provider's content moderation (DeepSeek HTTP 400 'Content Exists Risk' / INVALID_REQUEST) rejects an entire request, and because the loop re-derives the whole conversation from the session log on every turn, one stored record that trips it makes every later turn of that session fail - even a two-character new message (discussions #7181, #6495, #6476). Mounted on the public llm/stream waterfall, this plugin inserts a space between every pair of adjacent non-space characters in the newest messages, escalating from a small rung to the whole request only as far as the provider's own rejection proves necessary, and re-dispatches as a new object. A request that is never rejected is dispatched untouched: no tokens, no cache invalidation, no rewrite. Compatible with the dsh 0.1.2, 0.1.3, 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 prerelease lines.
